Bĭbĕsĭa , ae, f.,
I.Drinkland, a comically formed name, Plaut. Curc. 3, 74: “Perediam et Bibesiam Plautus finxit suā consuetudine, cum intellegi voluit cupiditatem edendi et bibendi,” Fest. p. 214, 28 Müll.; cf. Peredia.
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
